pages.text: Fish Oil is needed in order to make Polished Sticks and Polished Titanium Rods, which is what you need to create higher tier fishing rods. In order to obtain Fish Oil, you need to melt Fish in a Crucible Furnace.
pages.title: Fish Oil

pages.text: To craft the sticks, and rods you need to soak logs/planks/sticks or titanium rods in Fish Oil in a Vat.
$(l)Input:$() Titanium Rod$(br)$(l)Fluid:$() 6500mB Fish Oil$(br)$(l)Output:$() Polished Titanium Rod$(br)$(l)Time:$() 30s
pages.title: Polished Titanium Rod

pages.text: $(l)Input:$() Stick$(br)$(l)Fluid:$() 3 ingots Molten Titanium$(br)$(l)Output:$() Titanium Rod$(br)$(l)Time:$() 60s
pages.title: Titanium Rod
